record.title: Record your screen, camera or voice

screen.label: Screen
screen.hint: Record a tab, window or full screen

screenCamera.label: Screen + camera
screenCamera.hint: Two clips: your screen and a small camera clip in the corner

voice.label: Voice only
voice.hint: Record a voice-over for this scene

record.microphoneHint: Adds your voice to screen and camera recordings
record.limitNote: One recording can be up to {minutes} minutes. It is saved in your Storage folder “Recordings” and added at the playhead.
record.limitPlan: Your plan accepts files up to {limit} MB each.
record.unsupported: This browser can't record. Try Chrome, Edge or Firefox on a computer.
record.screenUnsupportedTitle: This browser can't record the screen

requesting.title: Waiting for your permission…
requesting.screen: Choose what to share in the browser window.
requesting.camera: Allow the camera and microphone in the browser prompt.
requesting.voice: Allow the microphone in the browser prompt.

ready.title: Ready to record
ready.hint: Press Start recording when you are ready.
ready.voiceHint: Say a few words to check the level.

record.micUnavailable: No microphone is available, so this recording will have no sound.
record.limitSoon: The recording stops by itself in {seconds} s.

review.title: Your recording
review.tooLarge: This recording is {size} MB, more than the {limit} MB your plan accepts per file. Retake a shorter one.
review.limitReached: The 10-minute limit was reached, so the recording stopped.
review.interrupted: The recording was interrupted. What was captured until then is kept as your take.

persist.uploading: Saving your take to the Recordings folder… {percent}%
persist.saved: Your take is saved in the Recordings folder. A reload or another project will not lose it.
persist.failed: Your take is only in this page until it is saved. Download it so it is not lost, or try again.

notes.video: It is added to the scene at the playhead.
notes.pair: Adds the screen clip and a small camera clip in the bottom-right corner. You can move and resize the camera clip afterwards.
notes.voice: A voice-over becomes the narration of this scene. It replaces the AI voice of the scene, if there is one. Press Ctrl+Z to undo.

saving.title: Adding your recording
saving.processingHint: Preparing the recording so it can be edited. This can take a minute.
saving.stalledHint: This is taking longer than usual. Your recording is safe in your Storage folder “Recordings”.

saved.title: Added to the video
saved.body: Your recording is on scene {scene}, at the playhead.

toast.narrationReplaced: Your recording replaced the narration of this scene. Press Ctrl+Z to undo.
toast.voiceRunsPast: The recording is {seconds} s longer than this scene, so it plays on into the next scenes.

errors.screenUnsupported: This browser can't record the screen. Try Chrome, Edge or Firefox on a computer.
errors.screenDenied: Screen sharing was cancelled or blocked.
errors.screenBusy: The screen couldn't be shared. Try again.
errors.recorder: The recording could not be created. Try again.
errors.tooLarge: The recording is larger than your upload limit, or your storage is full. Record a shorter take or free up space.
errors.unsupportedType: This recording format is not accepted. Try another browser.
errors.uploadFailed: The upload failed. Check your connection and try again.
errors.notReady: The recording is not ready yet. Try again in a moment.
errors.probeInvalid: The recording could not be read. Record it again.
errors.tooLong: The recording is longer than the editor accepts. Record a shorter take.
errors.attachFailed: The recording could not be added to the project. Try again.
errors.forbidden: You can't add recordings to this project.
errors.insertFailed: The recording is in your project but could not be placed. Put the playhead on a scene and try again.
